annotations.title: Latest stored registry record of one name

description: The latest stored registry record of one name: dates, registrar, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC and holder. Use it when someone asks who holds a name, when it was registered or when it expires. A stored record, not a live lookup. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: read, observedOn, observedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, expiresAt, registryUpdatedAt, registrar, eppStatuses, nameservers, dnssec, holder, transport.

name.description: A full domain name on an ending the catalog holds, lowercased, IDN as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an e-mail address or an unknown ending answers 400 `validation_failed` with `reason` and `suggestion`.

name: ud_get_name_registry
